notes.title: Special DLC : Youtube Play List DLC
notes.content:
New special DLC has released! If you purchase this DLC, you can now add your favorite songs in the play list and play in order of your selection. You can add infinite number of videos. But once you play the play list, you have to complete all the videos you have selected which means the difficulty will get harder and harder as you play the play list.
You can add or remove your favorite songs on play list by clicking the star in Youtube Play or Play List menu. 
If you like to play rhythm game with your favorite songs, DoDodge and this DLC will be worth to you!

notes.title: Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
There is a new patches : 
-From now on, all the new player's Youtube search character limit will be changed into 3 character.
    You can buy the character limit +1 by using your in-game gold. You can earn gold by playing the casual 
    mode.
-I have changed the interface of purchasing the search character limit.
    I changed 'Buy' into 'Buy with 10000G', so you can know how much it costs.

notes.title: Chess character has came to DoDodge!
notes.content:
We have a new character, chess pawn that has a jumping ability so you can jump over the music notes.
it's ability has a max cool time which is 4 second. You can press space bar to jump, and while you press space bar, the longer you jump the longer cool time.

Also, there is a new patches in-game.
-there is a system about special combo. This special combo system doesn't show on your screen, but it counts when you dodge the notes left and right alternately.
-Instantiating the notes system has changed. Before, it was just random, but now the notes will instantiate depend on your position.
-The interface of purchasing the search character limit has changed. You can more easily understand when the purchase window pop-up on your screen.

notes.title: New character in DoDodge!
notes.content:
DoDodge has released a new character in game. It is missile shaped character, and has an ability that can reduce 1 damage from crashing into music note. There is several updates in the game.
-Gold system.
 There is a gold system in the game. You can earn by playing the game and complete it. When you 
 complete the game, there is a score at the end. The gold will be added (score/1000) Gold. For example, 
 if you got 123456 score, you'll get 123 gold in that game.
-Youtube search character limit.
 Now, there is a limit with Youtube search. At first, the limit is up to 6 characters. But you can upgrade this 
 limit by purchasing with your in-game gold or real-payment.
